source_scope.source_state: Current recovered development working tree with concurrent in-scope local changes; the parent integrator must bind this evidence to the final committed tree.
source_scope.publication: No provider writes, commits, deployment or publication performed by this reviewer.
source_scope.authority: Owner requested comprehensive extraction improvement and an independent 600-coffee audit across 200 distinct US roasters, three distinct coffees each. No API keys and no additional incurred cost. Parent assigned deterministic runtime repairs and this audit record.

confirmed_findings.location: coffee-espresso-evidence.mjs: espressoSections / sectionReference; legacy coffee-page-metadata.mjs: explicitEspressoRecipe
confirmed_findings.evidence: An Espresso dose followed immediately by a Filter/V60/AeroPress/French Press heading could borrow that other method's output and time. The old metadata boundary ignored headings in the first 80 characters.
confirmed_findings.repair: Bound generic espresso sections structurally; stop at a competing method even when adjacent. Use the shared helper as the sole metadata recipe parser. Preserve the exact tab/control identity checks for Onyx guides.
confirmed_findings.coordination: pipeline_audit removed the legacy metadata parser and delegated exclusively to extractProductEspressoReference.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Ordinary colonless Espresso Recipe/Guide headings were skipped; shared-unit ranges were lost or collapsed. The old metadata parser converted an explicit 25s-30s recommendation into 25-25. New clock support was also tested against 0:25-0:30 and repaired before handoff.
confirmed_findings.repair: Accept explicit heading/label structures, retain gram and second ranges with units once or twice, parse bounded minute:second durations and ranges, reject malformed clock ranges, preserve temperature ranges as verbatim reference text. Preserve named equipment, dose tolerance and explicit Espresso|Filter ratio layout.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Repeated conflicting measurements or independent incompatible espresso recommendations previously selected a convenient first value.
confirmed_findings.repair: Reject conflicting repeated measurements and incompatible independent ranges. Do not construct a hybrid recipe. Published raw evidence remains eligible for the separate review disclosure.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Two components both explicitly described as Anaerobic Natural were counted as two different processing methods, incorrectly producing Other/Unknown. Natural Anaerobic and Natural Anaerobico with accent were equivalent cases.
confirmed_findings.repair: Normalize the explicit compound treatment to the existing Anaerobic category for method comparison while retaining the original component descriptions. A genuinely different Washed component still produces Other/Unknown.

confirmed_findings.evidence: A measured partial HTML recipe such as 20g in / 47g out prevented an exact-product endpoint from adding its matching published time or temperature. Only ratio-only references were previously enriched.
confirmed_findings.repair: Merge missing measurements only when independently published dose/output ranges corroborate the same recipe and shared values/equipment are compatible. Differing measured or named-equipment recipes stay separate. Preserve the selected complete recipe under the existing policy.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Differing farm/rest details and recipes lost the endpoint alternative, and conflicting altitude was silently selected. Source alternatives were unavailable for review.
confirmed_findings.repair: Withhold genuinely conflicting elevation; compare equivalent meter notation without a false conflict. Retain both supplementary/recipe source alternatives marked conflicting in source_facts. Preserve the chosen complete recipe and supplementary detail under existing behavior. Existing canonical conflicts remain final.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Endpoint adaptation retained a narrow canonical field set and dropped arbitrary published specifications. Shopify descriptions over 20000 characters and Woo descriptions over 16000 characters were not semantically parsed.
confirmed_findings.repair: After exact product identity validation, collect raw structured product facts and descriptions for bounded review. Merge these with selected-product extraction evidence. Propagate source_facts_truncated through adapters, serialization and preview merges. No additional endpoint request is introduced.
confirmed_findings.coordination: Root owns coffee-source-facts.mjs and the source-information UI. Its collector supports Woo terms, labeled Shopify tags, units, purchase options and long-description chunks.

confirmed_findings.evidence: Woo's exact-permalink adapter accepted bounded nested product paths, while the larger HTML retry guard rejected examples such as /product/coffees/world-class/samuel-jr/.
confirmed_findings.repair: Align retry eligibility with the adapter's validated bounded product ancestor and nesting pattern. Explicit category/admin ancestors, arbitrary shop paths and excessive nesting remain excluded. Retry still requires page_too_large and selected-product extraction evidence.

confirmed_findings.location: coffee-source-facts.mjs: collectCoffeeSourceFacts; coffee-espresso-tabs.test.mjs: first UI assertion
confirmed_findings.evidence: New generic review evidence legitimately contains a Filter tab's 205F value, causing an older assertion that forbids it anywhere in the entire preview to fail. The dedicated espresso reference remains exactly 20g/47g without an invented total time. The generic disclosure also needs method context so Coffee/Water/Time from different guides remain distinguishable.
confirmed_findings.repair: Parent owns refining the review context and narrowing the old assertion to the espresso reference. This reviewer did not edit the UI or source-facts module.

url_and_network: Public HTTPS only; reject credentials, alternate ports, fragments, literal IP hosts and unsafe URL forms.
Connect-time global IPv4 DNS pinning validates every returned A record and TLS identity; no browser cookies, member JWT, API key or caller headers go to roaster sites.
Every redirect requires a fresh validated pinned connection; redirect count remains bounded.

Default received and decompressed response caps remain 900000 bytes. Only an eligible specific product HTML response that exceeded the default can receive one 2000000-byte retry; JSON cannot use that retry.
zlib enforces the decompressed maximum during decompression. The shared source-retrieval deadline stays 15000ms and the ordinary per-request cap stays at most 11000ms.
No remote scripts, product HTML, JSON strings or instructions are executed. Selected-product parsing fails closed on ambiguous identities.
identity: Shopify exact handle and extracted title match are required.
Woo exact slug/title match and compatible returned permalink are required; nested product paths require that full permalink.
Ecwid requires a public configured or page-declared store ID, exact product ID and compatible title/canonical identity.
A product-shaped URL only permits a bounded fetch. It does not prove product identity.
application: Fresh authenticated admitted-member and verified-email checks precede source reads and cache return.
12 allowed preview claims per member per 24-hour window and the shared 30-second cooldown remain unchanged; endpoint IP rate limit remains 12 per minute.
Public warm cache remains bounded to 40 entries with a 15-minute TTL; no member tokens are cached.
One-click autofill fills blanks only. Supplementary facts and recipes are review-only; they are not saved or applied automatically.
The client rejects stale form/URL responses before applying fields. HTML output escapes source values.
retained_security_and_cost_controls.incremental_runtime_cost: Changes use local deterministic parsing and existing exact-product reads. No model, OCR service, API key, paid subscription, new crawl or additional endpoint request was introduced. Actual hosting costs are not represented as universally zero or unlimited.

residual_limits.location: netlify/functions/coffee-url-preview.mjs: completePreview / complete approved catalog shortcut
residual_limits.description: A catalog entry with all ten canonical fields can legitimately use the approved free cache path without reading the current page. It may lack newer or arbitrary source facts. This is not current-page completeness evidence.
residual_limits.audit_handling: Evaluate the 600-case source corpus with cold local replay and no catalog/warm-cache substitution; evaluate cache behavior separately.

residual_limits.description: IPv6-only, blocked, JavaScript-only, inaccessible image/PDF, unsupported-platform or oversized sources may remain unavailable to bounded runtime reads. An inaccessible fact is not an absent fact. Non-UTF-8 response bodies are decoded as UTF-8; no actual corpus failure has yet been established for that encoding limitation.
residual_limits.audit_handling: Record retrieval limitations, manual-only source facts and encoding explicitly instead of counting empty outputs as successes.

residual_limits.description: Blend interpretation requires bounded explicit Components evidence and complete integer percentages; unquantified or decimal blends may remain review-only. Recipe syntax and platform-specific structured containers are finite. Strict Ecwid title matching may safely reject changed SEO names. Larger endpoint descriptions retained for review are not guaranteed to populate every canonical field.
residual_limits.audit_handling: Score canonical extraction and total review retention separately, and enumerate observed missed forms.

residual_limits.description: Evidence is bounded to 128 items / 64000 characters, label 100 and value chunk 1600. HTML parsing also has node/depth/text budgets. A disclosed truncation is an honest limitation, not a claim that all source information was retained.
residual_limits.audit_handling: Audit presence of the review-limit notice and enumerate lost source facts; do not silently remove the case from the denominator.

residual_limits.description: The client preview request has no explicit AbortController deadline, although server source retrieval is bounded. A stalled browser-to-app request could leave the loading state pending. This is a code observation, not an observed live outage.
residual_limits.audit_handling: Parent may resolve within UI ownership; do not claim the server's source deadline bounds every application RPC or client network wait.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat Woo's public products/:slug Store API path as inherently invalid and replace it with a catalog search.
rejected_ideas.reason: Official Woo documentation explicitly supports Single Product by slug. Catalog reads would broaden cost and identity ambiguity without fixing a demonstrated defect.

rejected_ideas.idea: Use merchant/admin APIs, paid extraction models or hosted OCR to fill gaps.
rejected_ideas.reason: No keys/no additional incurred cost is the current owner constraint. Public product APIs and deterministic local parsing already cover the confirmed cases.

rejected_ideas.idea: Raise all response sizes, remove DNS checks or crawl product catalogs until every field is found.
rejected_ideas.reason: Would weaken explicit request and privacy limits and create unbounded cost. Preserve the source budgets and classify remaining inaccessible evidence honestly.

rejected_ideas.idea: Union conflicting countries, farms or recipes to increase field count.
rejected_ideas.reason: More filled fields are not more correct facts. Only explicitly sourced compatible fragments may combine; independent alternatives remain reviewable and conflicting canonical values are withheld.

rejected_ideas.idea: Automatically save arbitrary source facts or apply the roaster's recipe to the member's shot form.
rejected_ideas.reason: The existing data model and one-click blank-only flow do not authorize those writes. Reviewable evidence is within scope; new stored attributes or automatic recipe application need an actual product/data decision.

rejected_ideas.idea: Use extractor output, tags copied from it or a model reconstruction as the manual oracle; replace hard failures with easier coffees.
rejected_ideas.reason: That would make the audit circular and inflate coverage. Freeze independently selected products, read the source first and preserve failures/replacements transparently.

rejected_ideas.idea: Call the extractor complete because all ten canonical fields are populated or because 600 requests succeed.
rejected_ideas.reason: Field count does not establish source completeness. Unsupported but visible product facts, contradictions, unit context, inaccessible sources and missing recipes must be audited separately.

governing_decisions.preserve: Current deterministic/no-AI-key behavior supersedes the older BYOK proposal. Source-grounded narrative and blend facts may expand without inferring unavailable values.
900000-byte default, one specific-product 2000000-byte HTML retry, compressed/decompressed limits, pinned TLS/DNS, bounded deadline and semantic-preserving compaction.
12 claims per member/day and shared 30-second cooldown. Do not run a 600-case audit by bypassing production admission or quota.
One deliberate Autofill click, blank-only supported fields, member review and explicit Add Coffee. No automatic save/verification.
Do not use extractor work to redesign unrelated screens. Current broader source-evidence review is scoped to the existing preview disclosure.
Latest scope authorizes comprehensive deterministic development and independent evidence evaluation without keys or additional incurred cost. Development and integration do not authorize publication.

selection: Freeze a manifest of 200 distinct roaster businesses with official evidence of a US operation and exactly three distinct coffee products/releases each before the first extractor run.
Do not count bag sizes, grind choices, query aliases, retail/wholesale duplicates or subscription versions of the same coffee as distinct coffees. Preserve product identity and release context.

Sample platform/layout diversity, blends/single origins/decaf/processes/rare varieties and genuinely sparse pages. Record original candidates, ineligibility, unavailable sources and replacements with reasons.
Separate selection from extractor results. Never replace a failed extraction simply to obtain a passing case.
frozen_source_evidence: For every case preserve input/final URLs, retrieval UTC, HTTP/MIME/encoding, source byte counts and hashes, product HTML/endpoint captures, selected variant and relevant source image/tab/PDF references.
Keep official US-location proof and roaster identity source separately from coffee facts.
Distinguish the bounded runtime-readable source from independently rendered/manual-only content. A raw JSON product list is not proof that every website-only fact has been reviewed.
blind_annotation: Annotator reads the selected-product source before seeing extractor outputs. Lock expected facts and evidence locators first; the implementation cannot generate its own expected answers.

Capture every coffee-specific fact with original label, raw value, units/qualifier, method or component context, source URL/hash and quotation or locator. Assign a canonical field only where the product schema supports it.
Record expected action as autofill, review-only, conflict-withhold, absent or unavailable. Retain source contradictions rather than resolving them by guess.

Inventory origin, variety, producers, farm/co-op, process subtypes, fermentation/drying, altitude, dates/releases, tasting notes, roast evidence, rest advice, certification/grade/screen size/score, decaf method, every brewing recipe and commercial size/price/currency/availability option when published.

Keep filter and espresso measurements, different equipment, blend components and size variants distinct. Exclude navigation, shipping boilerplate and other products. Use a second source read for ambiguity or disagreements.
denominator_classes: Unambiguous selected-product fact accessible in runtime text/structured data.
Conflicting selected-product alternatives, requiring withholding and both alternatives for review.
Fact visible only in an image/PDF/JavaScript rendering or other source not accessible to the current bounded runtime.
Fact independently confirmed absent from reviewed source.
Source blocked, unavailable, oversized or not independently reviewed.
metrics: Product identity precision and cross-product contamination count.
Canonical precision: independently supported correct autofilled facts divided by all autofilled facts.
Canonical recall: correctly retained eligible canonical facts divided by independently observed eligible canonical facts.
Total review coverage: accurately reviewable observed product facts divided by all independently observed coffee-specific facts, including facts outside the canonical schema.
Conflict detection, both-alternative retention, qualifier/unit/range preservation and method/component context retention.
Report retrieval success separately from parsing and field coverage, and report inaccessible/manual-only source facts separately from absent facts.
Report by field, case, roaster and platform, using both macro and micro totals. Three coffees from one roaster are clustered observations, not independent evidence of universal reliability.
Raw/compacted source parity, review-limit notice visibility, blank-only form behavior and no automatic writes.
Bounded latency/CPU/bytes/requests/retries and cold-versus-warm behavior; no extrapolated hosting-cost guarantee.
acceptance: Zero known wrong-product, cross-method recipe, related-product, invented-value, unit/range corruption, privacy or security failures.

For every manually observed in-scope fact, demonstrate correct supported autofill or accurate context-preserving review retention with an explicit reason it is review-only. Any miss or truncation remains enumerated by case/field/source/root cause.
An inaccessible source is reported as an end-to-end limitation, not silently counted as absent or replaced. No unrecorded clipping or source dropping.

Do not declare a self-selected percentage threshold sufficient. If any target remains unmet, state the exact residual cases and scope. A pass applies only to the frozen corpus and tested version, not all possible roaster websites.

Hold out a roaster-level subset during implementation when feasible; source-based expected answers remain independent even after fixes. Run the final version over the complete frozen corpus and retain all results.
cost_controls: Prefer offline local replays of frozen public captures with bounded gentle per-host discovery. Do not send 600 member preview requests through production or bypass member quotas.
Use no paid model/OCR/API subscription or key. Do not assume that an existing hosted platform grants unlimited free compute; parent controls resource usage and final execution venue.
Preserve source retrieval and parser safety budgets. Record unavailable evidence and execution counts rather than removing limits to improve apparent coverage.
